name: pig-burning
comment: WP-2.2. Stone platform y = 60 over -8..8; three fire pits along x (centres x = -5, 0, 5, z = 0): a 3x3 netherrack floor (id 87) at y 60 with fire (id 51) on it at y 61 (netherrack keeps fire burning), inside a 2-high stone wall (y 61..62), so each pig stays in its fire. Pigs 0 and 2 fall in from y 65: outside fire, moveEntity sets fire = -fireResistance (-1), and the first contact's ++fire makes it 0, so 300 (Entity.java:522-532); they burn, and dropFewItems (rand.nextInt(3)) gives cooked porkchops (EntityPig.getDropItemId: fire > 0). Pig 1 is spawned inside the fire (vanilla quirk, transcribed): its fire starts at 0, so contact only makes it 1 and Entity.onEntityUpdate's --fire 0 again; it never gets 300 and would drop raw porkchops (its nextInt(3) draw is 0 here). Contact: dealFireDamage(1) every tick, only 1 point per 10-tick hurt-resistance window counts (heartsLife, field_9346_af); Entity.onEntityUpdate's fire % 20 hit; hurt timers and the hurt sound's draws; death, deathTime to 20, setEntityDead, 20 explode particles; the drops burn in the fire. rng_state and entity_state every tick.
